geometry-cpu.scope: Flat leaf proportion uses all weighted samples. Inclusive unknown root frames can occur in otherwise resolved Rust stacks; this is not the fraction of unusable leaves. O3/debug0 does not establish inline source ownership.
geometry-cpu.loss_scope: Not exposed by this signal sampler. Nominal time/nearby proc CPU is NOT a loss-rate estimate. Standard signal coalescing, multithread timer semantics, boundary and proc accounting differ. PROFILE evictions are flushed hash entries, not dropped samples.
